existing_proofs_preserved: Both full source loops, the uncast second input load, fp32 variance/sqrt and source-dependent division/multiply precision are represented across 216 floating triples. FullExactIO includes trace safety, successful flattened execution, all active streamed outputs and frame. Index-only equivalence retains complete backend states/failures. Existing sm90 offline evidence records both admitted and rejected profiles and is preserved as compilation-only evidence.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Complete two-pass row computation, including source-specific second-pass promotion and masked weight load, is covered.
The batch/M grid, allocation, strides and B4096/16-warps wrapper remain uncomposed.

dtype_review: Unlike a hypothetical missing dtype, the retained native_lowering_sm90_triton_3_7_1.json actually reports four compiled nonfloating profiles outside the formal six-float Storage: i32/fp32/i32, fp32/i32/fp32, i1/fp32/i1 and i32/i32/i32. This is offline source-admission evidence, not GPU execution or a universal profile theorem.
branch_review: Both passes and partial tails are already covered parametrically. The full_real_correct execution uses its documented zero undefined oracle; the source-equivalence theorem preserves arbitrary undefined values. No nonexistent wrapper shape assertion is claimed.

structural_gaps.finding: rmsnorm_wrapper allocates output and launches every (batch,M) row at B4096, while FullExactIO remains per-pid streamed IO.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: No theorem composes these source stages into the actual returned tensor and exact stride wiring.

structural_gaps.finding: Four nonfloating input/weight/output profiles compiled in retained source-bound sm90 evidence, but public theorems quantify only floating Storage.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Their integer/bool loads, promotions and output conversion routes are structurally absent, independently of numerical variance accuracy.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Native sums, sqrt, dtype-dependent division/multiplication and casts may be deferred at exact bindings. Offline compilation does not validate their numeric results.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
